content: Kutsa ca Iuano Muka Kumbuitika
Ha ntsimbu ije muene Helonde omo uevuile lutsimo lua Yesu,
kaha uahandekele kuli vangamba vendi nguendi, “Ou ikeye Iuano muka kumbuitika, vanamusangula ku vatsi, mukemo evi vinzili vili nakupanga muli ikeye.”
Omuo Helonde uakuatele Iuano nakumukuta nakumuhaka mu kamenga, omuo ya mulonga ua Helondiya mpuevo ya munaina Filipu,
omuo Iuano uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Kuya ku lishiko yove kuuapandele kumuambata.”
Cipue vene uatondele kumutsiha, vuno honi kamutsihile uateuele vantu, omuo vamuivuile nguavo uapuile kananguizi ua Njambi.
Omo litangua lia kuanuka kusemuka ca Helonde liahetele, muna Helondiya uampuevo uakinine hhakati ka civunga ca vantu kaha uavuahelesele Helonde,
kaha uamukulahesele nakulisinga kumuhana vioshe viatondele kulomba.
Omuo vaina vamusindiiye, kaha ualombele nguendi, “Njihane mutue ua Iuano muka kumbuitika ha lilonga.”
Vuno honi muene uovuile vusiua, vuno honi omuo hakulisinga cendi na hali vangezi vendi, kaha uashikile linga vamuhaneuo,
uatumine kukateta mutue ua Iuano mu kamenga.
Kaha mutue uendi vaunehele ha lilonga nakuuhana kuli muana mpuevo, kaha uauhanene vaina.
Kaha vandongisi va Iuano vezile nakuambata muvila uendi nakuutsinda, kaha vaile nakulekesa Yesu.
Yesu Alisa Vamala Vakupua Makulukazi Atanu (5, 0 0 0)
Honi omo Yesu uovuile eci, uahumine kuje mu vuato kaha uaile kumutambela ua likaliendi. Vuno honi omo vivunga vievuile eci, viamukavele ha mavu kuhuma ku vimbonge.
Omuo Yesu uaile ha ntunda uamuene civunga cakama, kaha uavovuililile ngozi, kaha uavakanguisile ku mishongo yavo.

Omo capuile cinguezi, vandongisi va Yesu vezile kuli ikeye nakuhandeka nguavo, “Cino cinapu cihela ca kuholoka, kaha litangua honi liatoko, kaha leka vivunga linga vaye ku membo linga vakalilandele viakulia vakevo vavenia.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Kuvapandele kuya, vahaneni vimo valie.”
Kaha vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Tuli lika na vimbolo vitanu na vatsi vavali.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Vineheni kuno kuli yange.”

Kaha uashikile vivunga linga vatumame ha muila, kaha uambatele vimbolo vitanu na vatsi vavali kaha uatalele kuilu, kaha uavikuisuile, nakutavuozola vimbolo nakuvihana kuli vandongisi vendi, kaha vandongisi vendi vavihanene ku vivunga.
Kaha voshe valile nakukuta. Kaha vakunguilile mitonga ya vimbazuvuila ya kushula ya kupua likumi na ivali.
Kaha vaje valile vapuile ngue makulukazi atanu a vamala, kuhumisako vampuevo na vanike.
Yesu enda ha Mema
Ambahoni Yesu ualekele vandongisi vendi linga vakovele mu vuato vaye kulutue luendi musinia tele ikeye acili na kuleka vivunga linga vaye.
Kaha hanima ya kuleka vivunga linga vaye, uaille helu lia munkinda lika liendi mukulombela. Uakele kuje likaliendi noho cinguezi,
vuno honi ha ntsimbu ije vuato vuakele hhakati ka cisali kaha vuakele nakulininganga na mankimba omuo mpunzi yakele nakuvuluisa.
Kaha ku vandemba Yesu uezile kuli vakevo, oku alinakuenda helu lia cisali.
Vuno honi omo vandongisi vendi vamumuene hali nakuenda ha cisali, vovuile liova cikuma kaha vahandekele nguavo, “Ndumba ya muntu!” Kaha vatambekele naliova.
Kaha hajevene Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Simpeni keti muteue yange vene.”
Kaha Petulu uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi, “Muene, nga yove, njileke njije kuli yove nange njende ha mema.”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Ija.” Kaha Petulu uahumine mu vuato nakuenda ha mema kuya kuli Yesu,
vuno honi omo uamuene mpunzi uateuele, kaha uaputukile kuvombela kaha uatambekele nguendi, “Muene njovole.”
Hajevene Yesu uoluele livoko liendi, nakumukuata kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Muntu ua lutsilielo lualundende, vika ku utsiliela?”
Kaha omo vakovelele mu vuato mpunzi yahuile.
Kaha vaje vakele mu vuato vamulemesele nguavo, “Muavusunga u Muna Njambi.”
Yesu Akanguisa Vaka Kuvavala mu Ngenesaleta
Kaha omo Yesu na vandongisi vendi vajavukilile musinia, vezile ku cihela ca Ngenesaleta.
Kaha omo vantu vakumutambela uje vamutantekeyele, vatumine voshe vaku cihela cije nakumunehela vaka kuvavala voshe,
Vamulombele linga vakuate cipue ku mukunduilo ua kazaku kendi, kaha voshe vaje vakuateleko vakangukile.
